C9000042.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 042 (Oka classification for minimal compact complex surfaces: Kodaira dimension zero and class VII.; papers: Every complex K3 surface is Oka; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_SEW_CHAIN.statement: The complete hypotheses of manuscript sew:chain imply sewing with a positive transverse radius uniform in every block length and the number of blocks.

C_SEW_LINEARIZE.statement: Exactness makes the transverse mean quadratic and gives the Hamiltonian-plus-shear decomposition in sew:linearize.

C_SEW_SPLIT.statement: The Fourier right inverse on the whole chain has bounds independent of all block lengths and chart count.

C_SEW_NEWTON.statement: Shear-conjugated Hamiltonian corrections cancel every first-order nonzero mode and leave a uniform quadratic normalized error.

C_SEW_MARGINS.statement: The Newton majorant preserves positive common margins and yields convergent corrections uniformly over all blocks.

C_SEW_COVER.statement: The corrected translated blocks cover the entire cylinder times one common transverse disc, with only adjacent overlaps.

C_SEW_EFFECTIVE_PARAMETRIC.statement: The same exact chain theorem holds jointly holomorphically with arbitrary passive complex parameters and uniform bounds, with b=r/4 and the explicit conservative threshold in report.md.

C_SEW_PASSIVE_HOLO.statement: With uniform active-coordinate bounds, all sewing primitives, Fourier sums, flows, limits and global chart identifications are jointly holomorphic in arbitrary passive complex parameters.

C_K3_OKA.statement: Manuscript thm:main: every complex K3 surface is Oka; this remains outside the conclusion of the sewing audit.

C_GEOMETRIC_L.statement: The manuscript's projective, degeneration, rational-direction, and dynamics arguments supply the two-family property L hypotheses at every K3 point.

C_DEG_SEAMS.statement: Manuscript deg:seams supplies uniform degree-one core/neck transitions satisfying sewing domains except exactness.

C_RATIONAL_STRIPS.statement: Manuscript rat:strips supplies buffered periodic symplectic strips under its stated deformation.

C_SEW_CENTERS.statement: Manuscript sew:centers adjusts periods exactly while updated centers admit uniform buffered chart choices.

C_TWO_FAMILIES_L.statement: Manuscript loc:criterion converts the stated two-family or long-disc hypotheses to property L.

C_PROPERTY_L_CAP.statement: Manuscript ana:cap promotes property L everywhere to CAP in every source dimension.

C_POLYDISC.statement: Manuscript ana:polydisc provides finite-radius approximation on successively larger polydiscs.

C_TRACE_GLUE.statement: Manuscript glue:trace supplies nonlinear interface splitting without a positive complex-normal-thickness bound.

C_SCOPE_EXTERNAL.statement: The genus-one and dense-period propositions cited in the broader manuscript are source-checking obligations, not black boxes in the sewing proof.
